confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on aggregated cost-of-living figures I found in two web searches. Expatarrivals gave July 2026 Lima averages in soles: cappuccino PEN 10, local draft beer PEN 9 and a mid-range meal for two PEN 100. MyLifeElsewhere and BootsNall gave crowd-sourced and guide ranges. I converted soles to dollars at about 3.4 to 3.6 PEN per USD, which is my own approximation and was not looked up. The inexpensive meal is set above the cheapest menu del dia to fit typical tourist districts like Miraflores and Barranco. The mid-range meal is set slightly above the Expatarrivals figure because restaurant prices in tourist areas run higher. I did not search cocktail or wine prices directly. They are estimated from local price relationships, with a pisco sour costing roughly three times a beer and a glass of wine at a restaurant roughly two to two and a half times a beer, so they are less certain. All four accommodation anchors are general model estimates based on Lima's tourist districts. I did not check any booking sites or listings, so these are the least certain values. FX is the RBA 4pm rate for 18 November 2026 as reported in search results.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lima is priced as a large Andean-Pacific Latin American capital, similar to Bogota and a little cheaper than Santiago. Values assume the main visitor districts of Miraflores and Barranco.
